sample: Your strike passes through the BRIGHTEST frame — light and noise. It was already gone; that frame is the past. (The faintest frame is the real present — close your eyes and swing at where it IS, or strike right after it moves.)
The frames are snapped together — for one heartbeat it is all HERE. You strike.
You STRIKE the buffering for 45 (Hunting spear).
